en.text: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，你们该效法 神，好像蒙慈爱的儿女一样。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，你們該效法上帝，好像蒙慈愛的兒女一樣。

en.text: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

zhSimplified.text: 也要凭爱心行事，正如基督爱我们，为我们舍了自己，当作馨香的供物和祭物，献与 神。

zhTraditional.text: 也要憑愛心行事，正如基督愛我們，為我們捨了自己，當作馨香的供物和祭物，獻與上帝。

en.text: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

zhSimplified.text: 至于淫乱并一切污秽，或是贪婪，在你们中间连提都不可，方合圣徒的体统。

zhTraditional.text: 至於淫亂並一切污穢，或是貪婪，在你們中間連提都不可，方合聖徒的體統。

en.text: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

zhSimplified.text: 淫词、妄语，和戏笑的话都不相宜；总要说感谢的话。

zhTraditional.text: 淫詞、妄語，和戲笑的話都不相宜；總要說感謝的話。

en.text: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

zhSimplified.text: 因为你们确实地知道，无论是淫乱的，是污秽的，是有贪心的，在基督和 神的国里都是无分的。有贪心的，就与拜偶像的一样。

zhTraditional.text: 因為你們確實地知道，無論是淫亂的，是污穢的，是有貪心的，在基督和上帝的國裏都是無分的。有貪心的，就與拜偶像的一樣。

en.text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

zhSimplified.text: 不要被人虚浮的话欺哄；因这些事， 神的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。

zhTraditional.text: 不要被人虛浮的話欺哄；因這些事，上帝的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。

en.text: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，你们不要与他们同伙。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，你們不要與他們同夥。

en.text: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

zhSimplified.text: 从前你们是暗昧的，但如今在主里面是光明的，行事为人就当像光明的子女。

zhTraditional.text: 從前你們是暗昧的，但如今在主裏面是光明的，行事為人就當像光明的子女。

en.text: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

zhSimplified.text: 光明所结的果子就是一切良善、公义、诚实。

zhTraditional.text: 光明所結的果子就是一切良善、公義、誠實。

en.text: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 总要察验何为主所喜悦的事。

zhTraditional.text: 總要察驗何為主所喜悅的事。

en.text: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

zhSimplified.text: 那暗昧无益的事，不要与人同行，倒要责备行这事的人；

zhTraditional.text: 那暗昧無益的事，不要與人同行，倒要責備行這事的人；

en.text: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们暗中所行的，就是提起来也是可耻的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們暗中所行的，就是提起來也是可恥的。

en.text: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

zhSimplified.text: 凡事受了责备，就被光显明出来，因为一切能显明的就是光。

zhTraditional.text: 凡事受了責備，就被光顯明出來，因為一切能顯明的就是光。

en.text: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以主说： 你这睡着的人当醒过来， 从死里复活！ 基督就要光照你了。

zhTraditional.text: 所以主說： 你這睡着的人當醒過來， 從死裏復活！ 基督就要光照你了。

en.text: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

zhSimplified.text: 你们要谨慎行事，不要像愚昧人，当像智慧人。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。

en.text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

zhSimplified.text: 要爱惜光阴，因为现今的世代邪恶。

zhTraditional.text: 要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。

en.text: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

zhSimplified.text: 不要作糊涂人，要明白主的旨意如何。

zhTraditional.text: 不要作糊塗人，要明白主的旨意如何。

en.text: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

zhSimplified.text: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放荡；乃要被圣灵充满。

zhTraditional.text: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放蕩；乃要被聖靈充滿。

en.text: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

zhSimplified.text: 当用诗章、颂词、灵歌彼此对说，口唱心和地赞美主。

zhTraditional.text: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌彼此對說，口唱心和地讚美主。

en.text: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

zhSimplified.text: 凡事要奉我们主耶稣基督的名常常感谢父 神。

zhTraditional.text: 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父上帝。

en.text: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

zhSimplified.text: 又当存敬畏基督的心，彼此顺服。

zhTraditional.text: 又當存敬畏基督的心，彼此順服。

en.text: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 你们作妻子的，当顺服自己的丈夫，如同顺服主。

zhTraditional.text: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，如同順服主。

en.text: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

zhSimplified.text: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，如同基督是教会的头；他又是教会全体的救主。

zhTraditional.text: 因為丈夫是妻子的頭，如同基督是教會的頭；他又是教會全體的救主。

en.text: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

zhSimplified.text: 教会怎样顺服基督，妻子也要怎样凡事顺服丈夫。

zhTraditional.text: 教會怎樣順服基督，妻子也要怎樣凡事順服丈夫。

en.text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

zhSimplified.text: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，正如基督爱教会，为教会舍己。

zhTraditional.text: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，正如基督愛教會，為教會捨己。

en.text: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

zhSimplified.text: 要用水借着道把教会洗净，成为圣洁，

zhTraditional.text: 要用水藉着道把教會洗淨，成為聖潔，

en.text: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

zhSimplified.text: 可以献给自己，作个荣耀的教会，毫无玷污、皱纹等类的病，乃是圣洁没有瑕疵的。

zhTraditional.text: 可以獻給自己，作個榮耀的教會，毫無玷污、皺紋等類的病，乃是聖潔沒有瑕疵的。

en.text: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

zhSimplified.text: 丈夫也当照样爱妻子，如同爱自己的身子；爱妻子便是爱自己了。

zhTraditional.text: 丈夫也當照樣愛妻子，如同愛自己的身子；愛妻子便是愛自己了。

en.text: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

zhSimplified.text: 从来没有人恨恶自己的身子，总是保养顾惜，正像基督待教会一样，

zhTraditional.text: 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子，總是保養顧惜，正像基督待教會一樣，

en.text: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

zhSimplified.text: 因我们是他身上的肢体。

footnotes.text: - 5:30 有古卷加：就是他的骨他的肉

zhTraditional.text: 因我們是他身上的肢體。

footnotes.text: - 5:30 有古卷加：就是他的骨他的肉

en.text: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

zhSimplified.text: 为这个缘故，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

zhTraditional.text: 為這個緣故，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。

en.text: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

zhSimplified.text: 这是极大的奥秘，但我是指着基督和教会说的。

zhTraditional.text: 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指着基督和教會說的。

en.text: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

zhSimplified.text: 然而，你们各人都当爱妻子，如同爱自己一样。妻子也当敬重她的丈夫。

zhTraditional.text: 然而，你們各人都當愛妻子，如同愛自己一樣。妻子也當敬重她的丈夫。
